title: Elon Musk's "Loop" - It's bad, folks
premise: The presenter argues that Musk’s Loop is an underground urban freeway whose real construction, safety, elevator and exit-street constraints undermine its magical marketing, while gadgetbahn promises divert policy from publicly owned conventional transit.
coverage: Read full compact ASR, all64 original sheets/757 indexed frames, five native targeted stills, QA Sargon/collage/ending strips and opening spectrogram; also individually registered/viewed five supplemental canonical images758–762, now represented in dedicated panels. Full speech source-word-derived. Automated sound candidates use the required Unverified audio candidate prefix and do not claim listening or confirmed identity. Empty sound arrays mean unannotated, not silence. Sparse sampling may miss brief gags; motion uses adjacent visual evidence.
